== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Republic At War / Aggressive Negotiations (Errata)]] (<code>1291_69</code>, Virtual Block 9.1, 7 side), showing the '''PC-E1 (7 side)''' game text. Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text. The 7 side (Aggressive Negotiations) only, drawn over the art of Thrown Back, the card the 7-side slip is pasted over; paragraph lead words in bold as on the PC card image.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee forum, “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574), post p901169 by darkjediknight11, 8 August 2014: https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=40#p901169
* '''PC-E1 (7 side) text:''' “'''0 side — Republic At War''' ''Deploy Forward Command Center and Begun, The Clone War Has.'' For remainder of game, Rebels and Rebel starships are lost. You may forfeit non-lightsaber weapons (using forfeit value = 3); place your just forfeited weapon in Used Pile. Your Destiny is suspended. You lose no Force to Vengeance Of The Dark Prince. While this side up, once per turn, may ▼ an [Episode I] battleground. Flip this card if a complete [Clone Army] Mission on table. '''7 side — Aggressive Negotiations''' Immediately place X (limit 3) cards from hand on bottom of Used Pile then draw up to X+1 cards from Reserve Deck once per game. While this side up, opponent's battle destiny draws are -1. During your control phase, may use 2 Force to ▲ a [Clone Army] character, starship or vehicle. Your total power in battles is +Y, and whenever you win a battle, retrieve up to Y Force, where Y = the number of 'complete' [Clone Army] Missions on table.. Flip this card if you have no 'complete' [Clone Army] Missions on table.”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 74) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card, with the PC-E1 (7 side) game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB9-07-Republic_At_War_Aggressive_Negotiations-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B41 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
